title: 1-Year Mortality Prediction through Artificial Intelligence Using Hemodynamic Trace Analysis among Patients with ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction
summary: Retrospective 605 STEMI/PPCI cases; arterial pressure wave features plus demographics, 10-fold procedure. Pressure-only AUC .73–.77; with covariates best LDA AUC .82, 1-year accuracy/sensitivity 77%/75% in reported best comparison.
